nuisance_policy: no posthoc nuisance refit; no row selection beyond frozen low-z mask; no amplitude tuning from residuals
covariance_policy: Pantheon full covariance restricted to the frozen low-z row mask; covariance slicing rule must preserve source_row_index ordering
channel_amplitude_policy: single source-frozen void amplitude grid on the low-z mask only; no per-row or residual-driven amplitude changes
information_criterion_shell: AIC_lowz = chi2_lowz_distance + 2*k_shared; report BIC_lowz only after n_eff is fixed to included low-z rows
pass_condition_shell: candidate can be interpreted only if low-z AIC improves over baseline, survives wrong/shuffled controls, and uses no endpoint leakage fields
notes: This freezes a possible future low-z Pantheon void replay grammar. It does not compute residuals, likelihoods, information criteria, endpoint scores, or validation results.
